cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

mechanism: A manages a tea visit with caring gifts that increasingly sound final, yielding the seating arrangement to keep B present while anticipating goodbye.
confusable: Simple generosity lacks the growing finality attached to each warmer act.
comparison: Travel alternative involves provisions for a short journey rather than a visit interpreted as potentially the last.
seedUse: Teacup seed supplies caring souvenir and departure ambiguity; S02 must react to B wish to remain rather than simply push the person out.
